description: Checks that the coilyco tailnet answers before agent-compose downloads, so an outsider gets one clear sentence. Installs nothing.
notes: This only gates agent-compose's first install. It leaves nothing behind and can be removed with scoop uninstall agent-compose-gate.
pre_install: try { if (-not $c.ConnectAsync('forgejo.coilysiren.me', 443).Wait(3000)) { throw 'timeout' } } catch { if ($dir) { Remove-Item (Split-Path $dir) -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; throw 'agent-compose is only available on the coilyco tailnet. If you''re on the tailnet and have access, connect and retry. If you''re the general public, you don''t have access to this.' } finally { $c.Dispose() }
